## add

OPERATOR FUNCTIONS

Adds two Percentage values


```solidity

```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`a`|`Percentage`|The first Percentage value|
|`b`|`Percentage`|The second Percentage value|

**Returns**

|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`Percentage`|The sum of a and b as a Percentage|

## Constants
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/percentage/contracts/Percentage.sol)

#### PERCENTAGE_DECIMALS
These operators allow for intuitive arithmetic and comparison operations
on Percentage values

Overridden operators declaration for Percentage

The number of decimals used for the percentage
This constant defines the precision of the Percentage type


```solidity
uint256 constant PERCENTAGE_DECIMALS = 18
```

#### PERCENTAGE_FACTOR
The factor used to scale the percentage
This constant is used to convert between human-readable percentages
and the internal representation


```solidity
uint256 constant PERCENTAGE_FACTOR = 10 ** PERCENTAGE_DECIMALS
```

#### PERCENTAGE_100
Percentage of 100% with the given `PERCENTAGE_DECIMALS`
This constant represents 100% in the Percentage type


```solidity
Percentage constant PERCENTAGE_100 = Percentage.wrap(100 * PERCENTAGE_FACTOR)
```

#### PERCENTAGE_1
Percentage of 1 with the given `PERCENTAGE_DECIMALS`
This constant represents 1 in the Percentage type


```solidity
Percentage constant PERCENTAGE_1 = Percentage.wrap(PERCENTAGE_FACTOR)
```



## Percentage
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/percentage/contracts/Percentage.sol)

**Title:**
Percentage

**Author:**
Roberto Cano

Custom type for Percentage values with associated utility functions

This type is used to represent percentage values with high precision

This contract defines a custom Percentage type and overloaded operators
to perform arithmetic and comparison operations on Percentage values.

Custom percentage type as uint256


```solidity
type Percentage is uint256
```
